notes:
• Player: separate Audio, Subtitles and Video buttons (icons; on TV the name shows when you land on one). Each opens its own panel with room for long track names, and tabs at the top to hop between them (Left/Right on the remote)
• Audio panel: tracks, Sound (Original, Dialogue boost, Night mode) and Audio sync. Video panel: Picture and Speed. Info sits before Next Episode
• Player menus are see-through, so the video stays visible behind them
• Phones and tablets: double-tap the left or right side to skip 10 seconds; keep tapping to skip further
• Updates now install through Android itself: one tap to confirm on most TVs, and on Android 12 and newer no prompt at all after this update. ValFlix shows what's new after updating
• TV: the update notes can be scrolled with the remote (press Up from the buttons)
